name: review-bridge
description: Coordinate isolated local review and audited GitHub publication.

interface.shortDescription: Gate local and GitHub code review
interface.longDescription: Create immutable Claude or Codex review snapshots or explicit remote-only publication authorizations, then bind GitHub Codex, checks, threads, and merge verification to one head.
